usedFor: Mails.so checks if emails are deliverable, with “Validate Email Address” for one and “Validate Bulk Emails” for many.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in Lemon Squeezy, then “Validate Email Address” in Mails.so
bestTemplate.why: A new order brings a customer's email, and the check says whether it is deliverable.

watchOut: Any email you send after “Validate Email Address” still waits in Needs you for your approval.
